name: DSK-1 "Deathstrike" seeker droid
description: The DSK-1 Deathstrike seeker droid was a battle droid developed by Arakyd Industries. The droid had a diameter of .4 meters and was armed with six mounted blaster pistols. The droid's normal mode of transportation was to hover through the air, though its special repulsorlift coils gave the droid the appearance of a rolling sphere. The droid had 360 degree vision and was fond of using tactical fire that completely filled a large area with blaster fire.
